body_lead: Born In Bihar, Now UK's First AI Minister: Who Is Kanishka Narayan? Last Updated: From studying at Oxford and Stanford to entering British politics and now leading the country's artificial intelligence agenda. 1/6 Indian-origin Labour MP Kanishka Narayan has been appointed as the UK's first cabinet-level Minister for Artificial Intelligence (AI) by Prime Minister Andy Burnham. His appointment reflects the UK's growing focus on artificial intelligence, innovation and digital policy. Here's everything you need to know about him.
